book_title: Pip and the One Good Perch
passage_text: Pip spots one good perch on the window box. Ned wants the perch too. Olive wants the perch too. Moss wants the perch too. They can not all fit on one perch. Pip has a plan: take turns. Pip sits first, then it is Ned. Then Olive gets a turn on the perch. Then Moss gets the last turn. Pip grins. Turns are a good plan.
